content: Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, Arrays nneɣ yareḥḥmen n ikehhanen
S uyenni ittxeṣṣa aneɣ ad newc taynit ktar i min nesřa, ḥima war nᵉtteffeɣ zeg webrid.
Minzi, mařa awař i innan lmalakat tuɣa tbedd u marra wi t isřin, maca iɛdu xas, aqa ittwaxeǧeṣ s řḥeqq,

mammec i ɣa negg ad narweř neccin, mařa nesseḥqara timesřayin i iǧan d Tudart i neccin, timesřayin i xef tuɣa issawař Siditneɣ ɣar umezwaru, uca xenni ttwaḍemnent aneɣ zeg yinni jaraneɣ i tuɣa tent zzayes isřin,
umi AREBBI iched akidsen s řeɛřamat d lmuɛjizat d řeɛjayeb ifarzen u s tmewci n Arruḥ Iqeddsen, tinni immewcen am mammec ixs Netta.
Minzi war issars ca zzman i dd ɣa yasen x tenni nessiweř, sadu řumur n lmalakat,
maca am mammec cehhdent u qqarent Tira Iqeddsen:
“Min iɛna bnadem, aqa Cek i dayes ittxarraṣen, u min iɛna Mmis n bnadem, aqa Cek i dayes itthillan?
Cek teggid t cwayt sadu lmalakat, teggid as aɛuǧi d ccan x uxeǧif nnes, tewcid as ṣṣulṭa x řexdayem n ifassen nnec.
Aqa marra timesřayin teggid tent sadu iḍaren nnes.”
Umi igga marra timesřayin sadu Netta, aqa war ijji walu war t iggi sadu Netta. Maca řexxu war nẓar ɛad marra ittwagg sadu Netta,

maca nettwařa belli Netta, aqa-t d Yasuɛ, tuɣa ittwagg cwayt sadu lmalakat di ssibbet n uweddeb n řmewt nnes, nettwařa i-t s ttaj n uɛuǧi d ccan x uzeǧif nnes, maɣar AREBBI iqqas řmewt i marra iwdan ɛlaḥsab arḍa nnes.
Minzi tuɣa ittřiq as i Netta s Wenni u i Wenni ǧant marra tmesřayin - Netta d Wenni i dd-ittawyen aṭṭas n iḥenjiren ɣar uɛuǧi - maḥend ad ikemmeř Uzeǧif n Tudart nsen s uweddeb nnes.
Minzi d Wenni issqeddsen d yinni ittwaqeddsen, nitni marra d ijjen. S uyenni Netta war iseḍḥi ca ad asen iřaɣa awmaten nnes,
umi inna:
“Ad barrḥeɣ i wawmaten inu s Yisem nnec, di řwesṭ n tmesmunt ad Cek ṣebbḥeɣ.”
Uca ɛawed:
“Necc ad dayes ttiqqeɣ!”
Uca ɛawed:
“Aqa da, Necc d tarwa i d ayi iwca AREBBI.”
Minzi tarwa carcen deg weysum d idammen, uřa d Netta icarc ammu kifkif di man aya, ḥima ad ibeṭṭeř s řmewt nnes wenni ɣar teǧa ṣṣulṭa x řmewt, aqa netta d cciṭan,
uca xenni ad ifekk inni isseɛddun qaɛ tudart nsen am isemɣan zi tiggʷudi n řmewt.
Minzi řmewt war ɣares teǧi ṣṣulṭa x lmalakat, maca řmewt ɣares ṣṣulṭa x zzariɛet n Ibrahim.
S uyenni tuɣa ittxeṣṣa as ad idweř am wawmaten nnes zi marra iɣezdisen, ḥima ad idweř d Arrays n ikehhanen arḥim d amtiqqi di min iǧan i AREBBI, uca ad yiři břa řɛib zi jjihet n ddnub n řgens.
Minzi min di tuɣa Netta simant nnes iweddeb u ittwajarreb, aqa izemmar ad iɛawen inni ittwajarrben.
